name: Quality Review Checklist
one_liner: 182 scored questions across ten management areas: did the project actually do what the plans said it would?
purpose: A Quality Review Checklist is a tool used throughout the project, when performing quality control, to check whether quality management activities have been performed as defined in the Quality Management Plan. It supports the Project Quality Reviewers in verifying that key project activities were carried out as expected and in identifying quality findings. Its consolidated findings and recommendations are the main input to the Quality Review Report.
created_in: Planning Phase (tailored with the Quality Management Plan) · used in Monitor & Control
approved_by: Not formally approved — tailored by the PM when planning quality; each completed review is signed off by the Project Quality Reviewer
inputs: Project Reports and previous review recommendations
gate: No gate of its own — the Phase-exit Review Checklist supports the RfP/RfE/RfC gates

lifecycle.what: Tailored to the project's defined quality control activities
Evidence accumulates; areas become applicable as work starts
Completed at the planned review frequency; scores areas
Final review feeds the Project-End Report and archived quality records

fields.f: Cover block — Organisation/Department, Project Name, PO, BM, SP, PM
fields.what: Identifies the project and the four governance roles whose work the review will judge, so findings can be attributed to a real accountability chain.
fields.who: PM fills before the review
fields.castor: ESM Lending Operations / IT & Digital · CASTOR · Florence Nightingale · Grace Hopper · Leonardo da Vinci · PM.

fields.f: Project Quality Reviewer and Review Date
fields.what: The person performing the quality review and the date. The reviewer verifies whether key project activities were performed as expected and identifies quality findings.
fields.who: PQA, an internal auditor, or an external entity — independent of the PM
fields.castor: W. Edwards Deming (PQA), review date 26 Mar 2027, at the Release 1 milestone.

fields.f: Area · % of Quality Compliance · Score · Included?
fields.what: Per-area roll-up. Each of the ten areas can be switched in or out of this review; excluded areas do not contribute to the overall score.
fields.who: PM tailors when planning quality · reviewer confirms
fields.castor: All ten areas included at Release 1; Outsourcing became applicable after contract award 18 Sep 2026.

fields.f: Overall Score and Overall Project Quality Assessment
fields.what: Weighted roll-up of the included areas, converted by the assessment key: below 0.7 means critical issues or major non-compliance, 0.7 amber, 0.9 green.
fields.who: Calculated · reviewer may override the RAG rating
fields.castor: CASTOR overall 0.82 — amber; two areas below 0.7 pull it down from green.

fields.what: 0 = No, nothing done. 5 = Yes, partially. 10 = Yes, meets PM² requirements. Questions starting 'How well…?' score 1–10. N/A = check not applicable.
fields.who: Reviewer scores each question
fields.castor: 'How well is the PM² methodology being used?' scored 8 by W. Edwards Deming; templates scored 7.

fields.what: Justification for the answer given. A score without a comment is not evidence — the comment is what makes the finding auditable.
fields.who: Reviewer writes · PM may respond
fields.castor: Against Risk Q10: 'R-07 was rated 16 but PSC approval recorded only in the MoM, not the Risk Log.'

fields.f: Recommendations sheet — ID, Findings, Impact, Recommendation, Action Details
fields.what: Documents findings and recommendations on quality assurance and control activities, with effort and responsible person for each action.
fields.who: PCT contributes the action plan · reviewers validate its adequacy
fields.castor: Finding 3: contractor status reports arriving late; action — Gustave Eiffel to submit by the 5th, 0.5 PD/month.

fields.what: Checks documented requestor needs, explicit in/out scope, a formal Scope Statement, needs mapped to deliverables, success criteria measurable, Charter approved by the PSC, assumptions, dependencies and acceptance criteria.
fields.who: Reviewer checks · PM and BM supply evidence
fields.castor: Charter approved 24 Mar 2026; SC1–SC5 measurable; all scored 10.

fields.what: Checks that deliverables trace from the Project Charter into the Work Plan WBS, that scope was agreed at the Planning Kick-off, and that WBS granularity fits the project.
fields.who: Reviewer checks · PM supplies the Work Plan
fields.castor: Scope agreed at the Planning Kick-off of 09 Apr 2026 and minuted; WBS granularity accepted.

fields.what: Checks a documented change process, a Project Change Management Plan, a maintained and regularly reviewed Change Log, Change Control Meetings, an escalation procedure, and PO/PSC approval of every scope change.
fields.who: Reviewer checks · PM owns the Change Log
fields.castor: CR-011 (SRF-backstop screens) correctly logged and decided by the PSC — no verbal scope change accepted.

fields.what: Checks a Project Work Plan exists (WBS, estimates, schedule), a consolidated Gantt, WBS linkage, granularity, business and project-management activities scheduled, measurable outputs, external dependencies.
fields.who: Reviewer checks · PM supplies
fields.castor: Work Plan baselined 26 Jun 2026; business implementation activities for 40 loan administrators included.

fields.f: Schedule › Activity Sequencing and Duration Estimation (Q10–16)
fields.what: Checks the critical path overall and per deliverable, agreed with the Core Team; and estimate accuracy, estimation by the people doing the work, peer review, reference projects.
fields.who: Reviewer checks · PCT and team leads supply evidence
fields.castor: Critical path runs through Release 2 (17 Dec 2027) into the parallel run; estimates peer-reviewed by Nikola Tesla.

fields.what: Checks that the schedule was baselined, that the baseline was approved, and that any re-baselining followed the change management process rather than quiet editing.
fields.who: Reviewer checks · PSC approved the baseline
fields.castor: Baseline approved at the RfE gate, 03 Jul 2026; no re-baselining to date.

fields.what: Checks tracking of task status and completion, regular schedule and critical path reviews, weekly resource allocation checks, over-allocation, and whether internal and subcontractor resources deliver to plan.
fields.who: Reviewer checks · PM and CPM supply actuals
fields.castor: Release 1 delivered 26 Mar 2027 on plan; Levallois resourcing flagged after the architect's departure.

fields.what: Checks that a Resource Plan exists, covers all resource types including training needs, and can be linked back to the WBS and the schedule.
fields.who: Reviewer checks · PM and BM supply
fields.castor: Resource Plan covers 3,100 PD and retraining of 40 loan administrators.

fields.what: Checks the provider team was involved, subcontract commitments are written, all requestor- and provider-side costs identified, the WBS drove estimating, PM effort included, cost of risk identified.
fields.who: Reviewer checks · SP and PM supply
fields.castor: €8.4 m includes ESM-side effort and contingency for the SRF-backstop ratification risk.

fields.f: Cost › Cost Budgeting and Cost Control (Q10–14)
fields.what: Checks budget approval, an appropriate payment schedule, purchase orders for all authorised purchases, active cost management, and the accuracy of duration-based percentage complete.
fields.who: Reviewer checks · PO owns the budget
fields.castor: Budget approved with the Business Case, 24 Mar 2026; Levallois payments tied to release acceptance.

fields.what: Checks how well PM² and its templates are used; whether the Quality Management Plan exists, is understood and PSC-approved; acceptance criteria and test plan; configuration procedure documented.
fields.who: Reviewer scores · PM supplies the plan
fields.castor: Quality Management Plan v1.0 approved by the PSC 26 Jun 2026; configuration procedure documented in section 9.

fields.what: Checks the configuration procedure is executed, the repository is current, a PQA role exists, quality is measured independently, deliverables are signed off, artefacts reviewed before reaching the requestor.
fields.who: PQA, PCT, BM or SP perform QA · external audits may be added
fields.castor: W. Edwards Deming confirms independent measurement; artefact peer review before every PSC pack.

fields.what: Checks control activities happen, corrective actions are taken, quality reviews follow the planned frequency, security and business-continuity activities are performed, and a project configuration log exists.
fields.who: PM performs QC · reviewer verifies
fields.castor: Configuration log maintained by Henry Gantt; security activities confirmed with Alan Turing (LISO).

fields.what: Checks the Risk Management Plan and Risk Log, involvement of both sides and the PCT, risk categories, quantified likelihood and impact, budget impact, escalation, PSC approval above risk level 15.
fields.who: Reviewer checks · PM owns the Risk Log
fields.castor: R-07 (loss of Levallois key architect) rated high and escalated to the PSC before it materialised.

fields.what: Checks high and very high risks are avoided or immediately reduced, a strategy exists per approved risk, contingency plans cover accepted risks, and response actions sit in the Work Plan.
fields.who: Reviewer checks · PM and risk owners supply
fields.castor: Backstop ratification risk accepted with a contingency; knowledge-transfer actions added to the Work Plan.

fields.what: Checks weekly Risk Log review, risks discussed in Follow-up, Core Team, Review and Steering Committee meetings, regular re-assessment, review when changes are approved, and mitigation actually carried out.
fields.who: Reviewer checks · PM chairs the reviews
fields.castor: Risk Log reviewed weekly; R-07 moved to the Issue Log when the architect actually left.

fields.what: Checks the issue process, Issue Management Plan, Issue Log and Decision Log, involvement of both sides, assessment by urgency/impact/size, effort, actions and owners, escalation, and that decisions follow escalation procedures.
fields.who: Reviewer checks · PM owns both logs
fields.castor: Decision Log carries D-014/D-015 from the PSC of 15 Oct 2026 on the SRF-backstop request.

fields.what: Checks the Issue Log is reviewed at appropriate intervals, how well issue status is monitored and reported, whether issues close in suitable time, and whether late items are followed up.
fields.who: Reviewer scores · PM reports status
fields.castor: Issue closure timeliness scored 6 — the Levallois architect issue stayed open longer than the target date.

fields.what: Checks a project contacts list (stakeholder matrix), an existing Communications Management Plan, documented meetings and reports, coverage of all stakeholders, and stakeholder comfort with the plan.
fields.who: Reviewer checks · PM supplies the plan
fields.castor: Communications Management Plan v1.0 of 26 Jun 2026 covers all six CASTOR stakeholder groups.

fields.what: Checks internal and external kick-offs were held, status is communicated per plan including to the PCT, follow-up and Core Team meetings happen, remote teams informed, steering meetings held as planned.
fields.who: Reviewer checks · PM and PSO supply evidence
fields.castor: Both kick-offs held (09 Apr 2026, 10 Jul 2026); monthly PSC held without a gap since July 2026.

fields.what: Checks minutes are published after meetings, meetings and reports keep the planned frequency, items are tailored to their audience, and escalation is documented, used and satisfactory.
fields.who: Reviewer checks · minute-takers and PM supply
fields.castor: Minutes published within two working days; escalation used once, for the verbal SRF-backstop request.

fields.what: Organization & Planning: documented roles, org chart, PSC in place, subcontracting, PCT capability, sufficient resources. Staff Acquisition: screening, agreements, evaluation criteria. Team Development: cooperation, teamwork issues, satisfaction 0–10.
fields.who: Reviewer checks · PM, SP and BM supply
fields.castor: Team satisfaction scored 7; off-site Levallois and on-site ESM cooperation improved after Release 1.

fields.what: Planning: contract outcomes understood, Outsourcing Plan, delivery schedule, processes and quality controls imposed on the outsourcer, evaluation criteria. Administration: corporate selection, signed contracts, legal review, SLAs, internal agreements.
fields.who: Reviewer checks · SP and CPM supply · AGB accountable for the Outsourcing Plan
fields.castor: Levallois Systems contract awarded 18 Sep 2026 through the corporate process; SLAs defined and legal-reviewed.

fields.what: Six 0–10 scores: satisfaction with schedule allowing for change requests, requirements, quality of deliverables, communication, technical ability of the PCT, and overall satisfaction.
fields.who: Reviewer collects from the requestor side — PO, BM and URs
fields.castor: Florence Nightingale scores communication 9, deliverable quality 6 after the reconciliation report dispute.

traps: It is a quality control tool; the audits and reviews it evidences are quality assurance.
Its output is the Quality Review Report — findings are also registered as issues in the Issue Log.
Phase gates use the Phase-exit Review Checklist, not the Quality Review Checklist.
Answers score 0/5/10; 'How well…?' questions score 1–10 instead.
N/A is valid per question, but marking a whole area N/A breaks the area total (known template defect).
